parsed.rationale_overall: System B offers stronger personalization by leveraging specific profile details (income bracket, savings rate, engineering background) and adds a highly actionable tax-optimization recommendation directly tied to FIRE acceleration. While System A has slightly better factual grounding and avoids some questionable claims (e.g., B's 'international outperformed US by 100%+' in 2000s), B's broader coverage of FIRE-critical levers (tax alpha, Roth bridge) and more concrete dollar-based actions give it the overall edge.
